ui.mdbb56adf87: How do I set up NFC?
ui.m363750df15: With a ready template, activate your item with its private code, set the destination and follow the PDF or video guide to write the CliQo link to NFC yourself. With a custom design, provide your link and artwork with the order; CliQo writes and tests NFC before shipping.
ui.m6cce77f7df: Does the QR change when I edit the page?

ui.mfbb5fd5742: Can I use the Landing Page for more than one piece?

ui.m87d1e2b663: Total link opens and button clicks. QR and NFC slots count together because they use the same link, and the number does not necessarily represent different people.

ui.m9624b05272: What’s the difference between NFC and QR?
ui.m3499027c4d: NFC opens the item link with a tap on a compatible phone. QR is scanned with a phone camera. Both open the same fixed CliQo link.
ui.mfde11a3ac0: NFC reading depends on the phone and its settings. Visitors can use the QR camera option if NFC is unavailable. Writing NFC for a ready template requires a compatible phone and app.
ui.mcf6b9962e3: How do I activate my item?
ui.m52fc68f850: Sign in, scan the QR to identify your item, then enter the private code from the package to claim ownership. Scanning the QR alone does not claim the item.
ui.m82cc191244: Do I need a new QR when I change the link?
ui.m2beceb977f: No. Your CliQo link and QR stay the same. Update the destination or page from your account within the purpose printed on your item.
